stemMd: Which practice most closely follows the author's reasoning?

options.label: A
options.textMd: A team assumes reproducibility guarantees relevance.

options.label: B
options.textMd: A software team uses a quick benchmark to reject slow prototypes but tests finalists on the actual workload before deployment.

options.label: C
options.textMd: A team selects software solely from a benchmark unrelated to its workload.

options.label: D
options.textMd: A team abandons all benchmarks after one discrepancy.

options.label: E
options.textMd: A team adds complexity to every test regardless of purpose.

explanationMd: The software practice assigns distinct roles to screening and final selection. That mirrors the passage's recommendation to match the strength and setting of the inference to the decision being made.

distractorRationale.e: The passage treats realism as a tradeoff.
distractorRationale.a: A stable test can consistently measure the wrong target.
